title: A TWO PLAYER RUN ENDS ON TIME
why: Found by the spare PC robots (noend): a two player run went on past its clock. When player 2 asks to join on another map, the host builds a fresh raid and keeps the clock only while it is above 0. Once the clock is out (the site burning, or the clock resting at 0 while the host boards), the new raid got a full 10 minutes. Player 2 now waits for the next run, the same as when the RUN OVER card is up.
now: A two player run ends when its clock runs out, even if player 2 presses A while the site burns.
